dedupe_keys.name: 名古屋市 洪水ハサートマッフ flood and disaster risk and hazard maps

description: 【名古屋市】洪水ハザードマップ [flood and disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 名古屋市. 想定し得る最大規模の降雨により、河川が氾濫した場合に想定される浸水区域、浸水深をシミュレーションにより算出したものです。 この図は、令和７年３月までに国土交通省または愛知県が公表した、各河川の洪水浸水想定区域図を基に浸水区域を重ね合わせ、作成しています。 浸水区域が重なる場合は、浸水深については深い方、浸水継続時間については長い方を表示し... Coverage: 名古屋市. The portal files it under the publisher 名古屋市. Its tags are ハザードマップ, 名古屋市, 防災. It offers 3 resource(s) in zip. The portal shows 2026-06-01 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
